title: Starting Gate Stills
eyebrow: BadCode Shorts · The Starting Gate · stills round 2
heading: The Starting Gate: stills
intro: Round 2 answers your notes: the mask is tweed on the shot you picked, and every still now matches GATE-a: SHARES is the dark bay (maroon and mustard silks), HOUSES the grey (black and orange), WAGES the chestnut with the white blaze (maroon, green and blue). Grey steel stalls everywhere. Your round 1 picks are kept below.

sections.lede: Words on the cloths and the mask are checked by eye; problems are written under each still.
